answers.drew: I’ve always known I wanted to pursue something creative and was always interested in drawing, painting, and music. At age 3 I got hooked on SpongeBob and started drawing cartoons in my free time which really influenced my creative interests. As I got older, I started watching more TV and realized I wanted to create my own show one day. Since then, I’ve known I wanted to pursue film and TV, and I’d love to work with animation!
answers.seeking: Anyone interested in film and tv! It’s great to hear about other people’s interests within the industry, even if I don’t end up in the same area as them.
answers.inspiration: I’d say Stan Lee, Donald Glover, and my grandpa. Stan Lee inspires me because he created such a vast universe from his imagination. Spider-Man has inspired generations of kids, and Stan Lee has changed how superhero stories are told by creating complex characters with real problems. Donald Glover inspires me because he’s been able to succeed in so many creative outlets with such a unique perspective. And my grandpa has instilled creativity into my life for as long as I can remember, taking me to art galleries, buying me painting supplies, and encouraging me to continue creating. I wouldn’t be where I am today without his support.
